# Youth

Welcome to the Youth area of the club website. Younger riders can take part in a range of age-appropriate cycling activities. Check the [club calendar](/club-calendar/) for the current programme.

## So What Is the Young Wheelers Awards Scheme?

The scheme encourages riders aged 16 and under who are full members of the Wheelers to take part in club activities. It includes two award programmes:

- Distance Awards
- Logbook Awards

## How Do I Register My Interest?

Contact [youth@chippenhamwheelers.org](mailto:youth@chippenhamwheelers.org) to register your interest and keep a record of activities such as youth time trials, volunteering and club events.

## Certificates and Badges

Successful completion of each stage earns a signed certificate and an enamel badge, presented at a suitable club event.

## What To Do If You Would Like To Know More

Please email [youth@chippenhamwheelers.org](mailto:youth@chippenhamwheelers.org) with any questions about awards and activities.
